Package shapes.utilities

package shapes.utilities
  • Related Packages
    Package
    Description
    shapes
     
  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    AISortUtility
    This class: - Provides AI-assisted sorting for Shape3D arrays - Sends numeric values to an external Python script for sorting - Receives a sorted index order and rearranges the array accordingly - Falls back to Merge Sort if the AI script fails or returns invalid data
    HeightComparator
    This class: - Compares two Shape3D objects based on their height - Sorts in descending order (taller shapes come first)
    NameComparator
    This class: - Compares two Shape3D objects based on their name - Sorts in ascending alphabetical order (A → Z)
    SortUtility
    This class: - Provides multiple sorting algorithms for Shape3D arrays - Sorts shapes in descending order based on the given Comparator - Contains only static methods (no objects of this class are created)
    SurfaceAreaCompartor
    This class: - Compares two Shape3D objects based on their surface area - Sorts in descending order (larger surface area comes first)
    VolumeComparator
    This class: - Compares two Shape3D objects based on their volume - Sorts in descending order (larger volume comes first)
